{{Short description|Indian hospital chain}} {{Use dmy dates|date=July 2020}} {{Use Indian English|date=July 2020}} {{Infobox company | name = Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited | logo = Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital.svg | image = | image_caption = | type = [[Public limited company|Public]] | traded_as = {{BSE|526783}} | ISIN = {{ISIN|sl=n|pl=y|INE934C01018}} | founded = {{start date and age|df=yes|1957}} | founders = [[Jaiveer Agarwal]]
Tahira Agarwal | hq_location_city = [[Chennai]], [[Tamil Nadu]] | hq_location_country = India | num_locations = | industry = [[Healthcare]] | products = [[Ophthalmology]] | area_served = India, Ghana, Kenya, Madagascar, Mauritius, Mozambique, Nigeria, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia | key_people = [[Amar Agarwal|Dr. Amar Agarwal]] (MD) | revenue = | operating_income = | net_income = | num_employees = | website = {{URL|www.dragarwal.com}} }} '''Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital''' is a chain of eye specialty hospitals in India, headquartered in [[Chennai]]. It was founded by [[Jaiveer Agarwal|Dr. Jaiveer Agarwal]] and his wife Dr. Tahira Agarwal as an eye care centre in Chennai. It has grown to 180+ centres across India and 15 centres overseas.{{cite news|url=http://healthcare.financialexpress.com/200807/coverstory09.shtml|title= Insight into Healthcare - Dr Agarwal's Eye Hospital, Chennai|date=July 2008|work=[[The Financial Express (India)]]}}{{Cite web |date=2022-08-05 |title=Dr Agarwals acquires five eye hospitals in Pune |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/dr-agarwals-acquires-five-eye-hospitals-in-pune/article65732164.ece |access-date=2022-08-05 |website=www.thehindubusinessline.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=110+ Eye Hospitals - Find Eye Hospitals Near You for Eye Check-up & Treatment Online |url=https://www.dragarwal.com/eye-hospitals/ |access-date=2022-08-05 |website=Dr. Agarwals |language=en-US}} [[Amar Agarwal|Dr. Amar Agarwal]] is the chairman and managing director of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital.{{Cite web|url=http://health.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hospitals/interview-dr-amar-agarwal-chairman-md-dr-agarwals-eye-hospital-chennai/49282756|title=Interview: Dr. Amar Agarwal, Chairman & MD, Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital, Chennai - ET HealthWorld|last=www.ETHealthworld.com|website=ETHealthworld.com|language=en|access-date=2019-07-11}} ==Founder== [[Jaiveer Agarwal]] born on 24 September 1930 along with his family members lead this hospital. He was the founder and chairperson of this hospital and also the recipient of the national award [[Padma Bhushan]] from [[APJ Abdul Kalam]] in March, 2006.{{cite news|url=http://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/tp-national/padma-awards-presented/article3167353.ece|title= Padma Awards presented|date=21 March 2006|work=[[The Hindu]]}} His wife Tahira Agarwal and son [[Amar Agarwal]] are both ophthalmologists. Jaiveer Agarwal died on 16 November 2009.{{cite news|url=http://healthcare.financialexpress.com/200912/market41.shtml|title= Founder of Dr Agarwal's Eye Hospital Passes Away|date=November 2009|work=[[The Financial Express (India)]]}}{{cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/Ophthalmologist-Jaiveer-Agarwal-passes-away/article16892538.ece|title=Ophthalmologist Jaiveer Agarwal passes away|date=16 November 2009|newspaper=[[The Hindu]]|first=Ramya|last=Kannan|access-date=19 July 2020}}{{cite web|title=Services at Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital|url=http://www.dragarwal.com/services/services.php|publisher=Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140221050010/http://www.dragarwal.com/services/services.php|archive-date=2014-02-21}} ==Centres== ===India=== [[File:Dr.Agarwal Eye Hospital.JPG|thumb|A branch of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital in [[Chennai]].]] Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital has 167 branches across 17 states in India. Some of the relevant are 18 each in [[Chennai]] and 20+ in rest of [[Tamil Nadu]], eleven branches in [[Bengaluru]], 10 branches in [[Hyderabad]] (Telangana - Dilsukhnagar, Gachibowli, Himayat Nagar, Madeenaguda, Mehdipatnam, Panjagutta, Santhosh Nagar, Secunderabad, Kukatpally & Uppal), 8 in Andhra Pradesh (Guntur, Nellore, Tirupati, Rajahmundry and Visakhapatnam (Main),{{cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/industry-and-economy/dr-agarwals-eye-hospital-enters-ap/article3401314.ecep|archive-url=https://archive.today/20140219162216/http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/industry-and-economy/dr-agarwals-eye-hospital-enters-ap/article3401314.ecep|url-status=dead|archive-date=19 February 2014|title=Dr Agarwal's Eye Hospital entered Andhra Pradesh with five branches|date=9 May 2012|work=[[The Hindu]]}} one branch each in [[Jaipur]] (Rajasthan), [[Port Blair]], Two branches in Kerala (Thiruvananthapuram & Kottayam), two branches in [[Kolkata]], three branches in the rest of [[Karnataka]] (Hubli and Mysore), two branches in [[Odisha]] (Cuttack and Bhubaneswar), 20 branches in Maharashtra (Pune, Vashi, Tardeo, Chembur and many more), 3 branches in Madhya Pradesh (Palasia, Annapurna, Ashta and 6 branch in Gujarat (Ahmedabad, Bhavnagar, Surat and Vapi).{{cite web|title=Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospitals Branches|url=http://www.dragarwal.com/branches.php|publisher=Dr. Agarwal's Eye the [[Mergers and acquisitions|acquisition]] of five hospitals in Maharashtra. ===Overseas=== Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital has one branch in [[Ghana]] ([[Accra]]), one branch in [[Kenya]] ([[Nairobi]]), Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital is a chain of eye specialty hospitals in India, headquartered in Chennai. It was founded by Dr. Jaiveer Agarwal and his wife Dr. Tahira Agarwal as an eye care centre in Chennai. It has grown to 180+ centres across India and 15 centres overseas.
Dr. Amar Agarwal is the chairman and managing director of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital.
